text:
sofia: FYI seeing a sustained spike of 502 responses from prom-remote-write-proxy in us-east1 since ~08:10. queue depth hitting 2000+ and connections exhausted
ben: ugh, did something roll? any correlating deploys around 08:00-08:05?
sofia: yes, gpu-exporter v2 rolled to all gpu nodes in that region at 08:03. raw scrape count jumped.
raj: can you paste the proxy logs (error lines) + a sample of exporter metrics?
sofia: logs:
infra-proxy[pm]: upstream conn pool exhausted, dial timeout, 502 from remote-write backend
sofia: sample metric from exporter:
GPU_TEMP_C{gpu_serial="GPU-abc123",node="gnode-12",instance_zone="us-east1-b"} 65.3
GPU_UTIL{gpu_serial="GPU-abc123",node="gnode-12"} 0.92
ben: looks like gpu_serial added per-device label. that explodes cardinality across the pool. remote_write payloads suddenly way bigger.
alex: two immediate options: 1) relabel gpu_serial away in scrape config before remote_write, 2) scale proxies or increase conn pool, 3) fallback to batched write with backpressure throttle.
sofia: can we patch relabel quickly? i can patch the prometheus ConfigMap and roll the scrape job.
raj: try relabeling first, that is lowest blast radius. snippet we used before:
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__name__"]
    regex: "GPU_.*"
    action: keep
  - source_labels: ["gpu_serial"]
    regex: ".*"
    action: drop
ben: careful: we still want per-node GPU counts for capacity metrics. drop gpu_serial but keep node label.
alex: also add a relabel to limit high-cardinality metrics (example):
- action: labelmap
  regex: "__name__:(.*)_debug"
  action: drop
sofia: applying patch to staging now, then prod can follow if green. patch command: kubectl -n observability patch configmap prom-scrapes -p '...relabel_configs...'
infra-bot: ALERT: prom-remote-write-proxy.us-east1 queue-depth > 1500 (firing)
raj: once relabel is live, watch remote_write queue and proxy conn metrics. if still high we scale proxies horizontally (replicas + connection pool tunables).
ben: also add temporary alert to SRE runbook to page on this specific exporter cardinality spike so on-call can triage faster next time.
sofia: patch applied to staging at 08:25, staging proxy queue dropped from 300 -> 12 within 2m. rolling to prod at 08:28.
alex: nice. for longer term we should update exporter docs to avoid gpu_serial in metrics or expose it behind a label allowlist + scrapers should drop it by default.
sofia: filing follow-up ticket in infra board to add relabel rule globally and update exporter repo.
ben: thanks team. leaving prod watch for 15m then will close. :thumbsup:
